_how_to: Settings Tech Risk can change without touching code. Save, deploy, then update the scorecard for the month.
Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. A trailing comma is fine.
_note_code_repo_url: The TRUST repo's web address on GitHub Enterprise Server, e.g. https://github.example.com/tech-risk/trust. With it set, each metric card links to the code behind the metric with the lines highlighted, at the deployed commit (or code_ref, default main). Empty = no links.
_note_repo_owner_rule: Who owns a GitHub repo (owner, 3 Nov 2026): most_commits (chosen) = the human with the most of the last 20 main-branch commits, a tie going to the most recent; last_commit = the last human to commit. Matched to HR by work email, then GitHub login = SAM_ACCOUNT; no match = Not yet mapped.
_note_repo_match_by: How a GitHub repo owner is found in HR (owner, 4 Nov 2026): email (chosen) = the commit's email address matches the person's HR work email; email_then_login also tries GitHub login = SAM_ACCOUNT when the email doesn't match.
_note_checkmarx_match_min: How sure TRUST must be before it ties a Checkmarx repo to a GitHub repo whose name isn't the same (owner, 4 Nov 2026). Tried first: the same full name, then the same repo name after the last '/' (so 'leading/reponame' finds 'org/reponame'). Only then a close spelling at this score or above. Case, '-', '_' and other punctuation are always ignored. 1.0 = no other differences; 0.9 = small differences like a missing letter ('card-servce'). Names must have the same numbers in them ('service2' never matches 'service'). Lower than 0.9 risks pairing different repos that share a stem, like 'payments-api' and 'payments-ui'. Between 0.5 and 1. Every close match is listed with its score.
_note_repo_active_days: A repo is active when it isn't archived or a fork and had a push or main-branch commit in this many days before the end of the month.
_note_repo_owner_flag_count: List anyone who comes out as the owner of this many active repos or more, to check a bulk change didn't make them the owner everywhere.
_note_area_match_min: How sure TRUST must be before it matches an ITDR application's Business Product Area to a family name or an HR Department that isn't spelled exactly the same (owner, 3 Nov 2026). 1.0 = exact only; 0.85 = close spellings like 'Payments Tech' and 'Payment Technology'; lower = looser. Between 0.5 and 1. Every close match is listed with its score on the upload result so it can be checked.
_note_subteam_hr_column: Which HR column names the sub-teams shown on family pages and in the drill-down (owner, 3 Nov 2026): Department or Supervisory Organization. Change, deploy, then update the scorecard.
_note_hr_root_sam_account: The CTO's SAM_ACCOUNT, set once here (owner, 3 Nov 2026). TRUST finds the CTO in the HR file by this value only, never by job title, and keeps the CTO and everyone reporting up to them; the rest of the firm is never stored. Empty = HR uploads are refused. After changing it, upload the HR file again (HR is cut down to the CTO's line as it arrives).
_note_team_grouping: Which teams the scorecard reports on (owner, 3 Nov 2026). product_family (the default) = the product family owners file (product_line_owners.json or the CSV): everyone under a product line's lead or leads in HR belongs to it; anyone under no lead is listed as Not yet mapped. l3 = each person at level l3_level from the top in HR, with everyone under them rolled into their team, named after them; people above that level are Not yet mapped; the owners file isn't used. Change, deploy, then update the scorecard.
_note_app_active_statuses: Which app inventory app_status values count as an active application (owner, 6 Nov 2026: confirmed only). Other apps are counted on the upload result but not placed or linked.
_note_app_org_match_min: How sure TRUST must be before it matches an app's org (the second part of app_org_hierarchy) to an HR Supervisory Organization (without the '(Manager Name)' part) that isn't spelled exactly the same (owner, 6 Nov 2026). 1.0 = exact only. Between 0.5 and 1. Every close match is listed with its score.
_note_app_itdr_match_min: How sure TRUST must be before it links an app inventory app_name to an ITDR Application Name that isn't spelled exactly the same (owner, 6 Nov 2026: app_id doesn't map to ITDR). Between 0.5 and 1; every close match is listed.
_note_itdr_family_from_inventory: Owner, 6 Nov 2026: an ITDR application linked to an app inventory app (by name) takes that app's family instead of its Business Product Area's; unlinked ones keep the Business Product Area. Its DR tests and the family's Tier 0/1 status follow. false = Business Product Area only, as before.
_note_app_repo_match_min: How sure TRUST must be before it ties an app inventory service_repo to a GitHub repo whose name isn't the same (owner, 6 Nov 2026: 'a reasonably close match'). Same rules as checkmarx_match_min.
_note_l3_level: The HR 'Management reporting level from top' that leads a team when team_grouping is l3 (owner, 3 Nov 2026: 3).
